description: This file defines the MockBasicCluster class, a mock implementation of a device cluster used for testing or simulation purposes. It includes attributes such as manufacturer, model, hardware version, and firmware version, and handles specific commands and attribute data retrieval.

classes.name: MockBasicCluster
classes.description: A mock implementation of a device cluster for testing, with attributes for manufacturer, model, hardware version, firmware version, and command handling.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Retrieves byte array data for a given attribute based on its ID.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Handles commands sent to the cluster, such as resetting to factory defaults.

methods.name: setDefaulted
methods.description: Sets the defaulted state of the cluster.

methods.name: isDefaulted
methods.description: Returns whether the cluster is in defaulted state.
